title: Love Island Text
blurb: "I've got a text!" — the alert that governs life inside the Love Island villa, followed immediately by the collective scream it always triggers. In the show it means the producers are about to detonate something; on the internet it means the same thing anywhere. The genius is that the sound arrives before anyone knows what the message says, so it's pure suspense with no content attached. Play it when any message lands that's about to change everything: the results, the reply, the "we need to talk".
origin: The dramatic text-arrival sound from Love Island UK.
